title: ProspectingAgentUserSpec - Data API
description: Represents a Prospecting Agent user specification.

ProspectingAgentDataSourceId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProspectingAgentDataSourceId.description: A reference to the parent ProspectingAgentDataSource. (Null means user specification is at the agent definition level.)

ProspectingAgentSpecId.description: A reference to the parent ProspectingAgentSpecification.

UserId.description: The ID associated with the parent user.

UserType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
UserType.description: The type of user. Possible values are: LibraryUser - Library User LicensedRep - Licensed Rep

special_access_rules: This object is available if Agentforce Prospecting is enabled in your org and your org has an Agentforce for Sales or an Agentforce for an Industry add-on license. To access this object, you need the Sales Agentic Prospecting Manager user permission.
